lines.text: **[FORM OF WRITTEN CONSENT IN LIEU OF MEETING OF THE LIMITED PARTNER ADVISORY COMMITTEE OF ARDENT CAPITAL PARTNERS III LP]{.underline}**
**Adopted Pursuant to Section 9.4 of the Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership of Ardent Capital Partners III LP, dated as of April 15, 2019**
**Effective as of February 14, 2024**
**[RECITALS]{.underline}**

This Written Consent (this \"Consent\") is executed by the undersigned members of the Limited Partner Advisory Committee (the \"LPAC\") of Ardent Capital Partners III LP, a Delaware limited partnership (the \"Fund\" or \"Ardent Capital Partners III LP\"). The LPAC is duly constituted pursuant to Section 9.4 of the Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership of the Fund, dated as of April 15, 2019 (as amended, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, the \"LPA\"). Each capitalized term used but not otherwise defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to such term in the LPA.

Section 9.4 of the LPA authorizes the LPAC to act by written consent in lieu of a meeting, provided that such written consent is executed by all members of the LPAC then serving and is delivered to the General Partner in accordance with the notice provisions of the LPA. Section 9.4 further requires the prior written consent of the LPAC for certain material actions proposed to be taken by the General Partner, including, without limitation, material changes to the management structure of the Fund, material amendments to the organizational documents of the General Partner or the Management Company, changes to the carried interest allocation among the principals of the Fund\'s management platform, and the departure or replacement of senior investment professionals (other than Key Persons, whose departure is separately addressed under Section 5.2 of the LPA).

The matters set forth herein were presented to, discussed by, and reviewed by the members of the LPAC at a virtual meeting of the LPAC held on February 14, 2024, at which representatives of the General Partner and its legal counsel were present and responded to questions from the LPAC members. Following such discussion and review, the undersigned members of the LPAC hereby adopt the following recitals and resolutions by written consent effective as of the date first written above.
**Identification of the General Partner**

Ardent Capital GP III LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the \"General Partner\" or \"GP\"), is the sole general partner of the Fund, having been admitted as such upon the formation of the Fund. The principal office of the General Partner is located at 590 Madison Avenue, 28th Floor, New York, New York 10022.
**Background on the Proposed Restructuring**

**WHEREAS**, the General Partner has proposed a comprehensive restructuring of the management company and realignment of economics among the principals of the Fund\'s management platform (the \"Restructuring\"), as more fully described in the materials provided to the LPAC and summarized herein;

**WHEREAS**, the General Partner notified the LPAC of the Restructuring by letter dated February 5, 2024 (the \"Notification Letter\"), and has provided the LPAC with a detailed presentation memorandum summarizing the Restructuring, including the proposed entity structure, ownership realignment, economic reallocation, and departure arrangements (the \"LPAC Presentation Memorandum\"), copies of which have been made available to each LPAC member through the Fund\'s secure data room;

**WHEREAS**, as of the date hereof, the Fund has total capital commitments of Two Billion Eight Hundred Million Dollars (\$2,800,000,000) from forty-seven (47) limited partners, with the General Partner having made a commitment of Forty-Two Million Dollars (\$42,000,000), representing approximately 1.5% of total commitments to the Fund;

**WHEREAS**, Ardent Capital Management LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and investment adviser registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, as amended (CRD #298417) (the \"Management Company\" or \"ManCo\"), currently serves as the investment adviser and manager of the Fund, providing investment management, portfolio monitoring, and administrative services to the Fund pursuant to the terms of the Investment Management Agreement, dated as of April 15, 2019, between the Fund and the Management Company;

**WHEREAS**, the current members and principals of the General Partner and the Management Company are Marcus Aldridge, Managing Member and Chief Investment Officer; Priya Narayanan, Managing Member and President; David Kellner, Senior Partner; Joanna Trask, Partner; and Robert Hsiao, Partner (collectively, the \"Current Principals\"), each of whom currently holds membership interests in the General Partner and the Management Company and participates in the carried interest and management fee economics of the Fund;
**Background on Entity Restructuring**

**WHEREAS**, the General Partner proposes to form Ardent Capital Holdings LLC, a new Delaware limited liability company (\"HoldCo\"), as a parent holding company of both the General Partner and the Management Company, in order to streamline the organizational structure of the Fund\'s management platform, facilitate the orderly transition of economics and governance, and provide a unified holding structure for the management of current and future Ardent-sponsored investment vehicles;

**WHEREAS**, the General Partner further proposes to form Ardent GP Intermediate LLC, a new Delaware limited liability company (\"GP Intermediate\"), as an intermediate holding entity between HoldCo and the General Partner, in order to provide structural flexibility for the management of the General Partner\'s obligations and liabilities, including the General Partner\'s capital commitment to the Fund and its clawback and indemnification obligations under the LPA;

**WHEREAS**, following the completion of the Restructuring, HoldCo will be the sole member of both the Management Company (directly) and GP Intermediate (directly), and GP Intermediate will be the sole member of the General Partner, and the individual principals will hold their economic and governance interests at the HoldCo level, thereby consolidating ownership and control at a single holding company tier;
**Background on Departures**

**WHEREAS**, David Kellner, Senior Partner, has informed the General Partner of his intention to retire from the Ardent platform effective as of March 31, 2024, and, following such retirement, Mr. Kellner will transition to a Senior Advisor role pursuant to a Senior Advisor Agreement to be entered into between Mr. Kellner and the Management Company, under which Mr. Kellner will provide transitional advisory services to the Fund\'s investment team on a part-time, non-exclusive basis for a period of up to twelve (12) months following his departure;

**WHEREAS**, Joanna Trask, Partner, has informed the General Partner of her intention to depart from the Ardent platform effective as of April 15, 2024, and Ms. Trask will not assume any continuing advisory or consultative role with the Fund, the General Partner, or the Management Company following her departure;

**WHEREAS**, the LPAC has been informed and acknowledges that neither Mr. Kellner nor Ms. Trask is a \"Key Person\" as defined in Section 5.2 of the LPA (the designated Key Persons being Marcus Aldridge and Priya Narayanan), and accordingly the departures of Mr. Kellner and Ms. Trask, individually or in the aggregate, do not constitute a \"Key Person Event\" under Section 5.2 of the LPA and do not trigger the suspension of the investment period, the Key Person cure period, or any other remedial provisions set forth in Section 5.2;
**Background on Economics Realignment**

**WHEREAS**, the Restructuring involves the reallocation of carried interest and management fee profit share economics among the remaining principals and two next-generation principals, namely Elena Marchetti, Vice President, and Samuel Okonkwo, Vice President (together with the remaining Current Principals, the \"Continuing Principals\"), in order to incentivize and retain the investment professionals responsible for the ongoing management of the Fund\'s portfolio and the successful realization of the Fund\'s remaining investments;

**WHEREAS**, following the completion of the Restructuring, membership interests in HoldCo and the allocable carried interest with respect to the Fund (as a percentage of the aggregate carried interest pool) will be held as follows:
**Principal**           **HoldCo Membership Interest**   **Carried Interest Allocation**
Marcus Aldridge         42%                              42%
Priya Narayanan         36%                              36%
Robert Hsiao            14%                              14%
Elena Marchetti         4%                               4%
Samuel Okonkwo          4%                               4%

**WHEREAS**, Mr. Kellner will retain one hundred percent (100%) of his vested carried interest in the Fund as of his departure date, and Ms. Trask will retain sixty percent (60%) of her vested carried interest in the Fund as of her departure date and will forfeit forty percent (40%) of her vested carried interest and one hundred percent (100%) of her unvested carried interest, in each case subject to clawback obligations as set forth in their respective separation and release agreements, and the forfeited carried interest will be reallocated among the Continuing Principals in accordance with the Amended and Restated Carried Interest Allocation Agreement;
**Background on LPA Amendment**

**WHEREAS**, the Restructuring requires the adoption and execution of Amendment No. 1 to the LPA (the \"LPA Amendment\") to reflect, among other things, (a) the restructured ownership of the General Partner through the HoldCo and GP Intermediate structure, (b) updated defined terms, including revised definitions of \"General Partner,\" \"Management Company,\" \"Principals,\" and related terms, (c) updated GP commitment provisions to reflect the assumption of the departing principals\' unfunded capital commitments, aggregating Three Million Four Hundred Two Thousand Dollars (\$3,402,000), by the remaining HoldCo members on a pro rata basis in accordance with their respective HoldCo membership interests, and (d) conforming amendments to Section 5.2 (Key Person), Section 8.3 (Transfer of GP Interest), and Section 9.4 (LPAC Consent) of the LPA;
**Background on Governance Documents**
**WHEREAS**, the Restructuring requires the negotiation, execution, and delivery of the following documents (collectively, the \"Restructuring Documents\"):
> \(i\) the Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of Ardent Capital Holdings LLC;
> \(ii\) the Limited Liability Company Agreement of Ardent GP Intermediate LLC;
> \(iii\) the Second Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of Ardent Capital GP III LLC;
> \(iv\) the Second Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of Ardent Capital Management LLC;
> \(v\) Amendment No. 1 to the Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership of Ardent Capital Partners III LP;
> \(vi\) the Amended and Restated Carried Interest Allocation Agreement;
> \(vii\) the Management Fee Sharing and Profit Allocation Agreement;
> \(viii\) the Separation and Release Agreement between the General Partner, the Management Company, and David Kellner, together with the related Senior Advisor Agreement;
> \(ix\) the Separation and Release Agreement between the General Partner, the Management Company, and Joanna Trask; and
> \(x\) all related ancillary documents, certificates, instruments, and agreements as may be necessary or advisable to effectuate the Restructuring;
**Confirmation of No Material Impact on Fund**

**WHEREAS**, the General Partner has represented to the LPAC, both in the Notification Letter and in the LPAC Presentation Memorandum and at the virtual LPAC meeting held on February 14, 2024, that the Restructuring will not result in any change to:
> \(i\) the Fund\'s investment strategy, investment objectives, or investment guidelines as set forth in Section 3.1 of the LPA;

> \(ii\) the management fee rates applicable to the Fund, which shall continue to be one and three-quarters percent (1.75%) per annum on committed capital during the investment period and one and one-half percent (1.50%) per annum on invested capital (less the cost basis of realized and written-off investments) thereafter, as set forth in Section 7.1 of the LPA;

> \(iii\) the carried interest rate applicable to the Fund, which shall continue to be twenty percent (20%) of net profits, subject to an eight percent (8%) per annum preferred return to limited partners and a full catch-up allocation to the General Partner, as set forth in Section 6.2 of the LPA;

> \(iv\) the term of the Fund, which shall continue to expire on December 31, 2029, subject to two successive one-year extensions at the sole discretion of the General Partner, as set forth in Section 10.1 of the LPA; or
> \(v\) the designation of the Key Persons under Section 5.2 of the LPA, which shall continue to be Marcus Aldridge and Priya Narayanan;

**NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the foregoing recitals and upon the representations made by the General Partner to the LPAC, the undersigned members of the LPAC hereby adopt the following resolutions by written consent effective as of the date first written above:
**[CONSENT RESOLUTIONS]{.underline}**
**Resolution 1: Consent to Formation of HoldCo**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to the formation of Ardent Capital Holdings LLC as a Delaware limited liability company to serve as the parent holding company of the General Partner (through GP Intermediate) and the Management Company, with membership interests in HoldCo to be held by Marcus Aldridge (42%), Priya Narayanan (36%), Robert Hsiao (14%), Elena Marchetti (4%), and Samuel Okonkwo (4%), and with governance, voting, and distribution rights as set forth in the Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of Ardent Capital Holdings LLC, a summary of which has been provided to the LPAC as part of the LPAC Presentation Memorandum.
**Resolution 2: Consent to Formation of GP Intermediate**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to the formation of Ardent GP Intermediate LLC as a Delaware limited liability company to serve as an intermediate holding entity between HoldCo (as its sole member) and the General Partner, and that the LPAC further consents to the admission of GP Intermediate as the sole member of the General Partner following the withdrawal of the Current Principals as individual members thereof, all as set forth in the applicable Restructuring Documents.
**Resolution 3: Consent to Amendment of GP LLC Agreement**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to the execution and delivery of the Second Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of Ardent Capital GP III LLC, in substantially the form summarized in the LPAC Presentation Memorandum, providing for, among other things:
> \(i\) the withdrawal of David Kellner and Joanna Trask as members of the General Partner, effective as of their respective departure dates;
> \(ii\) the admission of Ardent GP Intermediate LLC as the sole member of the General Partner;

> \(iii\) updated GP commitment allocation provisions reflecting the assumption of Three Million Four Hundred Two Thousand Dollars (\$3,402,000) in aggregate unfunded capital commitments of the departing principals by the remaining HoldCo members on a pro rata basis in accordance with their respective HoldCo membership interests; and

> \(iv\) updated indemnification, removal, and transfer provisions consistent with Sections 8.3 and 9.7 of the LPA, including provisions governing the circumstances under which the General Partner may be removed or replaced by the limited partners;

and the LPAC further confirms that the adoption of such Second Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement shall be consistent with the obligations and protections of the limited partners under the LPA.
**Resolution 4: Consent to Amendment of ManCo LLC Agreement**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to the execution and delivery of the Second Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of Ardent Capital Management LLC, in substantially the form summarized in the LPAC Presentation Memorandum, providing for, among other things:
> \(i\) the admission of Ardent Capital Holdings LLC as the sole member of the Management Company, replacing the Current Principals as individual members thereof;

> \(ii\) revised management fee profit distribution provisions, including the allocation of management fee profits among the HoldCo members in accordance with their respective membership interests and subject to such priority distributions, reserves, and expense allocations as may be set forth therein; and

> \(iii\) updated key-personnel provisions and regulatory compliance provisions, including provisions relating to the Management Company\'s obligations as a registered investment adviser under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, as amended, and the maintenance of the Management Company\'s Form ADV and compliance policies and procedures;

and the LPAC further acknowledges that the restructuring of the Management Company\'s membership and governance shall not affect the Management Company\'s obligations to the Fund under the Investment Management Agreement or otherwise modify the duties owed by the Management Company to the Fund and its limited partners.
**Resolution 5: Consent to LPA Amendment No. 1**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to Amendment No. 1 to the Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership of Ardent Capital Partners III LP, in substantially the form to be circulated to the limited partners for their consent or acknowledgment in accordance with the amendment provisions of the LPA, providing for, among other things:

> \(i\) amended defined terms reflecting the restructured ownership of the General Partner through the HoldCo/GP Intermediate structure, including revised definitions of \"General Partner,\" \"Principals,\" \"Management Company,\" and related terms;

> \(ii\) updated GP commitment provisions to reflect the assumption of the departing principals\' unfunded capital commitments, aggregating Three Million Four Hundred Two Thousand Dollars (\$3,402,000), by the remaining HoldCo members on a pro rata basis in accordance with their respective HoldCo membership interests, such that the total GP commitment of Forty-Two Million Dollars (\$42,000,000) shall remain unchanged; and

> \(iii\) conforming amendments to Section 5.2 (Key Person) to clarify that the designated Key Persons remain Marcus Aldridge and Priya Narayanan, to Section 8.3 (Transfer of GP Interest) to reflect the indirect holding of the General Partner\'s interest through GP Intermediate and HoldCo, and to Section 9.4 (LPAC Consent) to update cross-references and ensure consistency with the restructured organizational structure;

and the LPAC further acknowledges that the LPA Amendment shall be subject to such additional limited partner consent or acknowledgment requirements as may be set forth in the amendment provisions of the LPA and shall not become effective until all such requirements have been satisfied.
**Resolution 6: Consent to Carried Interest Reallocation**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to the Amended and Restated Carried Interest Allocation Agreement, providing for the reallocation of the carried interest pool (twenty percent (20%) of net profits) among the Continuing Principals and next-generation principals as follows:
> Marcus Aldridge --- 42%; Priya Narayanan --- 36%; Robert Hsiao --- 14%; Elena Marchetti --- 4%; and Samuel Okonkwo --- 4%;

with appropriate carve-outs and reserves for (a) David Kellner\'s retained vested carried interest (100% of vested carry as of March 31, 2024) and (b) Joanna Trask\'s retained vested carried interest (60% of vested carry as of April 15, 2024), in each case subject to clawback obligations as set forth in their respective Separation and Release Agreements and in accordance with the clawback provisions of Section 6.4 of the LPA; and the LPAC further acknowledges that the aggregate carried interest payable by the Fund to the General Partner and its affiliates shall not be increased as a result of the reallocation and that the reallocation is solely an internal matter among the principals of the Fund\'s management platform.
**Resolution 7: Consent to Departure of David Kellner**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to the departure of David Kellner as a member of the General Partner and the Management Company, effective as of March 31, 2024, and the LPAC hereby acknowledges that:
> \(i\) Mr. Kellner is not a designated Key Person under Section 5.2 of the LPA, and his departure does not constitute a Key Person Event;

> \(ii\) Mr. Kellner will transition to a Senior Advisor role pursuant to a Senior Advisor Agreement with the Management Company, under which he will provide transitional advisory services on a part-time, non-exclusive basis for a period of up to twelve (12) months;
> \(iii\) Mr. Kellner will retain one hundred percent (100%) of his vested carried interest in the Fund as of his departure date, subject to clawback obligations; and

> \(iv\) the terms of Mr. Kellner\'s separation, including all economic, restrictive covenant, non-solicitation, and confidentiality arrangements, are set forth in the Separation and Release Agreement between the General Partner, the Management Company, and Mr. Kellner, and the related Senior Advisor Agreement, summaries of which have been provided to the LPAC;
and the LPAC further acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to review and discuss the terms of Mr. Kellner\'s departure with the General Partner and its legal counsel.
**Resolution 8: Consent to Departure of Joanna Trask**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to the departure of Joanna Trask as a member of the General Partner and the Management Company, effective as of April 15, 2024, and the LPAC hereby acknowledges that:
> \(i\) Ms. Trask is not a designated Key Person under Section 5.2 of the LPA, and her departure does not constitute a Key Person Event;

> \(ii\) Ms. Trask will retain sixty percent (60%) of her vested carried interest in the Fund as of her departure date, subject to clawback obligations, and will forfeit forty percent (40%) of her vested carried interest and one hundred percent (100%) of her unvested carried interest, which forfeited amounts will be reallocated among the Continuing Principals in accordance with the Amended and Restated Carried Interest Allocation Agreement; and

> \(iii\) the terms of Ms. Trask\'s separation, including all economic, restrictive covenant, non-solicitation, and confidentiality arrangements, are set forth in the Separation and Release Agreement between the General Partner, the Management Company, and Ms. Trask, a summary of which has been provided to the LPAC;
and the LPAC further acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to review and discuss the terms of Ms. Trask\'s departure with the General Partner and its legal counsel.
**Resolution 9: Authorization to Execute Restructuring Documents**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby consents to the execution and delivery by the General Partner, on behalf of the Fund (to the extent applicable), and by the Management Company and the other parties thereto, of all Restructuring Documents, including without limitation all certificates of formation, certificates of amendment, operating agreements, amendments, separation agreements, advisory agreements, carried interest allocation agreements, management fee sharing agreements, and all other certificates, instruments, and agreements contemplated thereby or otherwise necessary or advisable to effectuate the Restructuring, in each case in substantially the form described in or consistent with the LPAC Presentation Memorandum, subject to such modifications as the General Partner may determine in good faith to be necessary or appropriate and that are not materially adverse to the interests of the limited partners of the Fund.
**Resolution 10: General Authorization**

**RESOLVED**, that the LPAC hereby authorizes the General Partner and each of its authorized officers, members, managers, and representatives to take all such further actions and to negotiate, execute, and deliver all such further documents, instruments, certificates, and agreements as may be necessary or desirable to carry out the purposes and intent of the foregoing resolutions, including without limitation the filing of any certificates or other documents with any governmental authority, the engagement of legal counsel, accountants, and other advisors, and the making of any notices, disclosures, or filings required by applicable law, regulation, or the terms of the LPA or any side letter.
**[ACKNOWLEDGMENTS AND LIMITATIONS]{.underline}**
The undersigned members of the LPAC hereby acknowledge receipt and review of the following materials in connection with the Restructuring:
> \(i\) the LPAC Notification and Consent Solicitation Letter dated February 5, 2024, from the General Partner to the members of the LPAC;

> \(ii\) the LPAC Presentation Memorandum, including all exhibits and appendices thereto, summarizing the Restructuring, the proposed entity structure, the economic realignment, and the departure arrangements; and

> \(iii\) summaries of each of the Restructuring Documents, including summary term sheets for the organizational documents, the LPA Amendment, the Carried Interest Allocation Agreement, the Management Fee Sharing and Profit Allocation Agreement, and the Separation and Release Agreements.

The LPAC\'s consent set forth herein is given solely pursuant to Section 9.4 of the LPA and in respect of the specific matters described in the resolutions above. This Consent shall not be deemed to constitute a waiver of any other rights of the LPAC or any individual LPAC member under the LPA, nor shall it be deemed a waiver of any rights, claims, or remedies of any limited partner of the Fund under the LPA, any side letter, or applicable law.

Nothing in this Consent shall modify, limit, or waive any rights, obligations, or protections of any limited partner under any side letter or supplemental agreement executed in connection with such limited partner\'s subscription to the Fund, including without limitation any most-favored-nation (\"MFN\") rights, expanded key-person provisions, enhanced fee transparency or fee reduction provisions, co-investment rights or obligations, information rights, restructuring consent or notification provisions, or any other supplemental or protective provisions contained in any such side letter or supplemental agreement. The General Partner shall comply with any notification, consent, or other requirements applicable to the Restructuring under any such side letter or supplemental agreement.

The LPAC reserves all rights to request additional information from the General Partner regarding the implementation and consummation of the Restructuring, including without limitation the right to request copies of executed Restructuring Documents (subject to any applicable confidentiality restrictions), updates on the transition of Mr. Kellner and Ms. Trask, and confirmation of the completion of the Restructuring and the effectiveness of the LPA Amendment.
**[GOVERNING LAW]{.underline}**

This Consent shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to the conflicts of law principles thereof that would result in the application of the laws of any other jurisdiction, consistent with Section 14.8 of the LPA.
**[COUNTERPARTS]{.underline}**

This Consent may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which, when taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of a signature page to this Consent by facsimile or electronic transmission (including portable document format (.pdf) or any electronic signature complying with the U.S. federal ESIGN Act of 2000 or the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act) shall be deemed delivery of an original executed counterpart and shall be effective as an original signature for all purposes.
**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the undersigned members of the LPAC have executed this Written Consent effective as of February 14, 2024.

19: **AGREEMENT OF LIMITED PARTNERSHIP**

21: **OF**

23: **HARROWGATE PRIVATE EQUITY FUND V LP**
24: 
25: This Agreement of Limited Partnership (this **\"Agreement\"**) of Harrowgate Private Equity Fund V LP, a Delaware limited partnership (the **\"Partnership\"** or the **\"Fund\"**), is entered into as of the date of the First Close (as defined below) by and among Harrowgate Fund V GP LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, as the general partner (the **\"General Partner\"** or **\"GP\"**), and each Person who is admitted as a limited partner of the Partnership (each, a **\"Limited Partner\"** or **\"LP\"** and, collectively, the **\"Limited Partners\"**), in each case in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth herein. The General Partner and the Limited Partners are sometimes referred to herein individually as a **\"Partner\"** and collectively as the **\"Partners.\"**
26: 
27: **RECITALS**
28: 
29: **WHEREAS**, the General Partner has caused a Certificate of Limited Partnership to be filed (or to be filed on or prior to the date hereof) with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware, forming the Partnership as a limited partnership under and pursuant to the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act, 6 Del. C. § 17-101 *et seq.*, as amended from time to time (the **\"Act\"**);
30: 
31: **WHEREAS**, the General Partner desires to establish the Fund as a private equity investment vehicle for the purpose of making equity and equity-related investments, directly or indirectly, primarily in North American mid-market and upper-mid-market companies in the industrials, business services, healthcare services, and technology-enabled services sectors;
32: 
33: **WHEREAS**, the General Partner is the sole general partner of the Partnership and is a Delaware limited liability company, the sole member of which is Harrowgate Capital Partners LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the **\"Sponsor\"**);
34: 
35: **WHEREAS**, the Sponsor has sponsored and managed four predecessor private equity funds (Harrowgate Private Equity Fund I LP through Harrowgate Private Equity Fund IV LP) and manages approximately \$5.8 billion in aggregate assets under management as of the date hereof;
36: 
37: **WHEREAS**, each Limited Partner desires to make a capital commitment to the Partnership on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement and in the Subscription Agreement executed by such Limited Partner; and
38: 
39: **WHEREAS**, the Partners desire to set forth their respective rights, obligations, and duties with respect to the Partnership.
40: 
41: **NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Partners hereby agree as follows:

43: **[ARTICLE I --- DEFINITIONS]{.underline}**
44: 
45: **[Section 1.1 --- Defined Terms]{.underline}**
46: 
47: As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:
48: 
49: **\"Act\"** means the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act, 6 Del. C. § 17-101 *et seq.*, as it may be amended from time to time, and any successor statute thereto.
50: 
51: **\"Adjusted Capital Account\"** means, with respect to each Partner, such Partner\'s Capital Account as of the end of the relevant Fiscal Year or other applicable period, as adjusted in accordance with Treasury Regulation Sections 1.704-1(b)(2)(ii)(d)(4), (5), and (6), after giving effect to the following adjustments: (a) credit to such Capital Account any amounts that such Partner is obligated to restore or is treated as obligated to restore pursuant to Treasury Regulation Sections 1.704-1(b)(2)(ii)(c), 1.704-2(g)(1), and 1.704-2(i)(5); and (b) debit to such Capital Account the items described in Treasury Regulation Sections 1.704-1(b)(2)(ii)(d)(4), (5), and (6). The foregoing definition is intended to comply with the provisions of Treasury Regulation Section 1.704-1(b)(2)(ii)(d) and shall be interpreted consistently therewith.
52: 
53: **\"Affiliate\"** means, with respect to any Person, any other Person that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with, such Person. For purposes of this definition, **\"control\"** (including the correlative terms \"controlling,\" \"controlled by,\" and \"under common control with\") means the possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of a Person, whether through ownership of voting securities, by contract, or otherwise, and shall be deemed to exist when a Person owns, directly or indirectly, fifty percent (50%) or more of the outstanding voting securities or equity interests of the applicable entity. Notwithstanding the foregoing, no Limited Partner shall be deemed to be an Affiliate of the General Partner, the Sponsor, or any other Limited Partner solely by reason of such Limited Partner\'s investment in the Fund.
54: 
55: **\"Aggregate Commitments\"** means the aggregate Capital Commitments of all Partners (including the GP Commitment), as set forth in the Schedule of Partners, as the same may be updated from time to time. At the hard cap, Aggregate Commitments shall not exceed Two Billion Dollars (\$2,000,000,000).
56: 
57: **\"Associate\"** means any member, partner, managing director, principal, officer, director, employee, or agent of the General Partner, the Sponsor, or any of their respective Affiliates.
58: 
59: **\"Benefit Plan Investor\"** means a \"benefit plan investor\" as defined in 29 C.F.R. § 2510.3-101(f)(2), as modified by Section 3(42) of ERISA, including (a) any \"employee benefit plan\" as defined in Section 3(3) of ERISA that is subject to Part 4 of Subtitle B of Title I of ERISA, (b) any \"plan\" as defined in Section 4975(e)(1) of the Code that is subject to Section 4975 of the Code, and (c) any entity whose underlying assets include \"plan assets\" by reason of a plan\'s investment in such entity.
60: 
61: **\"Blocker Entity\"** means HGF V blocker Corp., a Delaware C corporation formed for the benefit of certain tax-exempt or non-U.S. Limited Partners to mitigate UBTI or effectively connected income concerns, as the General Partner may determine to be appropriate in connection with the Fund\'s investment program.
62: 
63: **\"Bridge Financing\"** means any short-term Fund-level borrowing (whether under the Subscription Credit Facility or otherwise) used to fund Portfolio Investments or other Partnership obligations in advance of or in lieu of issuing Capital Calls, which borrowing shall not remain outstanding for more than one hundred eighty (180) consecutive days from the date of the applicable borrowing.
64: 
65: **\"Business Day\"** means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or a day on which commercial banks in New York, New York or Wilmington, Delaware are authorized or required by law or executive order to remain closed.
66: 
67: **\"Capital Account\"** means, with respect to each Partner, the capital account established and maintained for such Partner in accordance with Section 704(b) of the Code and Treasury Regulation Section 1.704-1(b)(2)(iv), as further described in Section 6.1 of this Agreement.
68: 
69: **\"Capital Call\"** or **\"Drawdown Notice\"** means a written notice issued by the General Partner to the Partners requiring such Partners to fund all or a portion of their unfunded Capital Commitments, specifying the aggregate amount of such capital contribution, the purpose thereof, and the date on which such funds are due, in accordance with Section 4.2 of this Agreement.
70: 
71: **\"Capital Commitment\"** means, with respect to each Partner, the aggregate amount that such Partner has committed to contribute to the Partnership as capital contributions, as set forth in such Partner\'s Subscription Agreement and reflected in the Schedule of Partners, as the same may be updated from time to time.
72: 
73: **\"Carried Interest\"** means the General Partner\'s right to receive twenty percent (20%) of Net Profits distributed in excess of the Preferred Return, as more fully described in Section 8.2 of this Agreement (Tiers 3 and 4 of the distribution waterfall).
74: 
75: **\"Carry Distribution\"** means any Distribution of Carried Interest to the General Partner pursuant to Tier 3 or Tier 4 of the distribution waterfall set forth in Section 8.2.
76: 
77: **\"Catch-Up\"** or **\"GP Catch-Up\"** means the distribution priority described in Tier 3 of Section 8.2, pursuant to which eighty percent (80%) of distributable amounts are allocated to the General Partner and twenty percent (20%) to the Limited Partners until the cumulative distributions to the General Partner under Tier 3 and Tier 4 equal twenty percent (20%) of the sum of all cumulative distributions under Tiers 2, 3, and 4.
78: 
79: **\"Cause\"** means (a) the commission of fraud or willful misconduct by the General Partner, any Key Person, or any Associate acting on behalf of the General Partner in connection with the affairs of the Partnership; (b) a material breach by the General Partner of this Agreement that is not cured within the applicable cure period set forth in Section 12.6; or (c) the voluntary or involuntary bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership, or dissolution of the General Partner.
80: 
81: **\"Clawback Amount\"** means the amount of excess Carried Interest subject to return by the General Partner to the Partnership pursuant to Article IX of this Agreement.
82: 
83: **\"Code\"** means the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended from time to time, and any successor statute thereto. References to specific sections of the Code shall be deemed to include corresponding provisions of any successor statute.
84: 
85: **\"Commitment Period\"** has the meaning ascribed to the term \"Investment Period.\"
86: 
87: **\"Concentration Limit\"** means, with respect to any single Portfolio Investment, twenty percent (20%) of Aggregate Commitments, measured at the time of the initial commitment to such Portfolio Investment (i.e., a maximum of Four Hundred Million Dollars (\$400,000,000) at the hard cap of Two Billion Dollars (\$2,000,000,000)), as more fully described in Section 5.3(a).
88: 
89: **\"Defaulting Partner\"** means any Partner that fails to fund its share of a Capital Call by the applicable funding date, as set forth in Section 4.9 of this Agreement, and that has not cured such failure within five (5) Business Days of the funding date.

91: **\"Distribution\"** means any distribution of cash, securities, or other property by the Partnership to one or more Partners, whether as a return of capital, a share of income or gain, or otherwise, as determined by the General Partner in accordance with this Agreement.
92: 
93: **\"Early Close discount\"** means the ten (10) basis point reduction in the Management Fee rate applicable to Limited Partners admitted to the Partnership at the First Close, as described in Section 7.1(c) of this Agreement (resulting in a Management Fee rate of 1.65% per annum on Capital Commitments during the Investment Period, in lieu of 1.75%).
94: 
95: **\"ERISA\"** means the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, as amended from time to time, and any successor statute thereto, together with all rules and regulations promulgated thereunder.
96: 
97: **\"Excess Organizational Expenses\"** means Organizational Expenses incurred by the Partnership in excess of Three Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars (\$3,500,000), which Excess Organizational Expenses shall be borne solely by the Sponsor and shall not be charged to the Partnership or any Partner.
98: 
99: **\"Excluded Co-Investment\"** means a co-investment opportunity offered alongside the Fund to one or more Limited Partners or third parties in accordance with Section 5.4, which co-investment is made through a separate co-investment vehicle or on a direct basis and is not treated as a Portfolio Investment of the Fund for purposes of this Agreement.
100: 
101: **\"Final Close\"** means the last date on which Limited Partners may be admitted to the Partnership and Capital Commitments accepted, which date shall be no later than the Final Close Deadline.
102: 
103: **\"Final Close Deadline\"** means February 15, 2027, being eighteen (18) months after the target date of the First Close.
104: 
105: **\"First Close\"** means the initial closing of Capital Commitments to the Partnership, targeted for August 15, 2025, at which the General Partner shall have accepted Capital Commitments aggregating at least Seven Hundred Fifty Million Dollars (\$750,000,000) (or such lesser amount as the General Partner may determine in its sole discretion).
106: 
107: **\"Fiscal Year\"** means the calendar year commencing on January 1 and ending on December 31 of each year; *provided*, that the first Fiscal Year of the Partnership shall commence on the date of the First Close and shall end on December 31 of such calendar year, and the final Fiscal Year of the Partnership shall end on the date of the final distribution of all Partnership assets and cancellation of the Certificate of Limited Partnership.
108: 
109: **\"For-Cause Removal\"** means the removal of the General Partner for Cause by a vote of a majority in interest of the Limited Partners (excluding GP-affiliated Capital Commitments) in accordance with Section 12.6(b).
110: 
111: **\"Fund\"** means Harrowgate Private Equity Fund V LP, a Delaware limited partnership formed pursuant to this Agreement.
112: 
113: **\"Fund Expenses\"** means the ordinary and recurring expenses of the Partnership borne by the Partnership, as more fully described in Section 7.4 of this Agreement.
114: 
115: **\"General Partner\"** or **\"GP\"** means Harrowgate Fund V GP LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, the sole member of which is Harrowgate Capital Partners LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, in its capacity as the sole general partner of the Partnership, and any successor general partner admitted to the Partnership in accordance with this Agreement.
116: 
117: **\"GP Catch-Up\"** has the meaning set forth in the definition of \"Catch-Up\" above.
118: 
119: **\"GP Commitment\"** means the Capital Commitment of the General Partner (or its Affiliates) to the Partnership, which shall be equal to two and one-half percent (2.5%) of Aggregate Commitments (equal to Fifty Million Dollars (\$50,000,000) at the hard cap of Two Billion Dollars (\$2,000,000,000)). The GP Commitment shall be funded pari passu with Capital Calls to the Limited Partners and on the same terms and conditions as the Capital Commitments of the Limited Partners, except that no Management Fee shall be charged with respect to the GP Commitment.
120: 
121: **\"Included Investors\"** means those Limited Partners that are (a) investment-grade institutional investors (as determined by the lender under the Subscription Credit Facility), (b) government plan investors, or (c) such other investors as may be included in the borrowing base under the Subscription Credit Facility, in each case whose unfunded Capital Commitments are pledged to secure such facility.
122: 
123: **\"Independent Auditor\"** means Caldwell, Fitch & Hartley LLP, or such other independent certified public accounting firm of national or regional standing as the General Partner may select from time to time, subject to LPAC approval for any change in the Independent Auditor.
124: 
125: **\"Investment Company Act\"** means the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended from time to time, and any successor statute thereto, together with all rules and regulations promulgated thereunder.
126: 
127: **\"Investment Period\"** means the period commencing on the date of the Final Close and expiring on the fifth (5th) anniversary of the Final Close, unless earlier terminated or suspended in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement (including Section 5.7 and Article X).
128: 
129: **\"Key Person\"** means each of Marcus J. Harrowgate and Diana R. Castellano, as identified in Schedule B.
130: 
131: **\"Key Person Event\"** means the occurrence of either Key Person ceasing to devote substantially all of his or her business time and professional efforts to the investment activities of the Fund and its Parallel Funds (excluding reasonable time devoted to (i) management and wind-down of predecessor funds (Harrowgate Private Equity Fund I LP through Harrowgate Private Equity Fund IV LP), (ii) civic, charitable, and educational activities, and (iii) personal investment activities that do not conflict with or detract from the Fund\'s investment activities), whether due to death, permanent disability, voluntary departure, termination, or otherwise, as more fully described in Article X.
132: 
133: **\"Large LP discount\"** means the additional five (5) basis point reduction in the Management Fee rate applicable to Limited Partners committing One Hundred Fifty Million Dollars (\$150,000,000) or more to the Partnership, as described in Section 7.1(c) of this Agreement (resulting in a cumulative Management Fee rate of 1.60% per annum during the Investment Period for a First Close Limited Partner committing \$150,000,000 or more).
134: 
135: **\"Limited Partner\"** or **\"LP\"** means each Person admitted to the Partnership as a limited partner in accordance with Article III of this Agreement and the Act, and **\"Limited Partners\"** means all such Persons collectively. For the avoidance of doubt, the term \"Limited Partner\" does not include the General Partner, except to the extent the General Partner holds an interest in the Partnership in its capacity as a limited partner (if applicable).
136: 
137: **\"Limited Partner Advisory Committee\"** or **\"LPAC\"** means the advisory committee of Limited Partner representatives established and maintained by the General Partner in accordance with Article XI of this Agreement.
138: 
139: **\"Management Fee\"** means the fee payable by the Partnership to the General Partner or its designee in consideration for the management and advisory services provided by the General Partner and its Associates to the Partnership, as set forth in Section 7.1 of this Agreement.
140: 
141: **\"MFN Election\"** means the Most Favored Nation election process described in Section 15.14 of this Agreement, pursuant to which qualifying Limited Partners may elect to receive the benefit of certain Side Letter provisions offered to other Limited Partners , with an election period of thirty (30) calendar days commencing upon delivery of the MFN Disclosure Notice, which the General Partner shall deliver within fifteen (15) Business Days after the Final Close.
142: 
143: **\"Minimum LP Commitment\"** means Ten Million Dollars (\$10,000,000), being the minimum Capital Commitment required to be made by each Limited Partner in order to be admitted to the Partnership, subject to waiver or reduction by the General Partner in its sole discretion.
144: 
145: **\"Net Asset Value\"** or **\"NAV\"** means, as of any date of determination, the fair market value of all assets of the Partnership (determined in accordance with the valuation policies adopted by the General Partner), less all liabilities of the Partnership (including accrued but unpaid Management Fees, Fund Expenses, and amounts owing under the Subscription Credit Facility), determined in a manner consistent with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States of America as applied by the General Partner on a consistent basis.
146: 
147: **\"Net Losses\"** means, for any Fiscal Year or other applicable period, the excess, if any, of the items of loss and deduction allocated to the Partnership over the items of income and gain allocated to the Partnership, in each case as computed for purposes of the Carried Interest allocation and the distribution waterfall set forth in Section 8.2.
148: 
149: **\"Net Profits\"** means, for any Fiscal Year or other applicable period, the excess, if any, of the items of income and gain allocated to the Partnership over the items of loss and deduction allocated to the Partnership, in each case as computed for purposes of the Carried Interest allocation and the distribution waterfall set forth in Section 8.2. For the avoidance of doubt, Net Profits shall be determined on a cumulative, whole-fund basis.
150: 
151: **\"No-Fault Removal\"** means the removal of the General Partner without Cause by a vote of seventy-five percent (75%) in interest of the Limited Partners (excluding GP-affiliated Capital Commitments) in accordance with Section 12.6(a).
152: 
153: **\"Offshore Feeder\"** means Harrowgate Fund V Offshore SLP, a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership formed to invest alongside the Fund for the benefit of certain non-U.S. investors and tax-exempt investors, as described in Section 2.7.
154: 
155: **\"Organizational Expenses\"** means the expenses incurred in connection with the organization and formation of the Partnership, the General Partner, the Parallel Fund, the Offshore Feeder, the blocker Entity, and any other parallel or related vehicles, including legal fees, accounting fees, filing fees, printing costs, travel expenses, and other expenses directly related to the formation and organization of the foregoing entities and the offering and sale of Partnership Interests, subject to the cap set forth in Section 7.3.
156: 
157: **\"Parallel Fund\"** means Harrowgate Fund V Parallel LP, a Delaware limited partnership, and any other parallel investment vehicle established by the General Partner to invest alongside the Fund on substantially similar economic terms, as described in Section 2.7.
158: 
159: **\"Partner\"** means the General Partner or any Limited Partner, and **\"Partners\"** means the General Partner and all Limited Partners collectively.
160: 
161: **\"Partnership\"** means Harrowgate Private Equity Fund V LP, a Delaware limited partnership, as constituted from time to time.
162: 
163: **\"Partnership Interest\"** means a Partner\'s entire interest in the Partnership, including such Partner\'s right to receive allocations and Distributions, the right to vote on matters submitted to the Partners, and all other rights and obligations of such Partner under this Agreement and the Act.
164: 
165: **\"Percentage Interest\"** means, with respect to each Partner, the ratio (expressed as a percentage) of such Partner\'s Capital Commitment to Aggregate Commitments, as set forth in the Schedule of Partners. Percentage Interests shall be adjusted upon the admission of additional Partners at Subsequent Closes.
166: 
167: **\"Person\"** means any individual, corporation, limited liability company, partnership, joint venture, association, trust, estate, unincorporated organization, governmental authority or body, or any other entity of any kind.
168: 
169: **\"Placement Agent\"** means Osprey Capital Markets LLC, a broker-dealer registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and a member of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), engaged by the Sponsor as exclusive placement agent for certain distribution activities in connection with the offering of Partnership Interests, as more fully described in Section 15.15.
170: 
171: **\"Portfolio Company\"** or **\"Portfolio Investment\"** means any Person in which the Partnership, directly or indirectly (including through one or more holding companies, special purpose vehicles, or other intermediary entities), acquires or holds an investment, whether in the form of equity securities, debt securities, convertible instruments, or other financial interests.
172: 
173: **\"Preferred Return\"** means a cumulative, compounded annual rate of return equal to eight percent (8%) per annum on each Partner\'s net funded Capital Contributions (adjusted for the timing of contributions and prior Distributions), computed from the date of each Capital Contribution through the date of Distribution, as more fully described in Tier 2 of the distribution waterfall set forth in Section 8.2.
174: 
175: **\"Qualified Purchaser\"** means a \"qualified purchaser\" as defined in Section 2(a)(51)(A) of the Investment Company Act and the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder.
176:

199: **\"Treasury Regulations\"** means the regulations promulgated under the Code by the United States Department of the Treasury, as such regulations may be amended from time to time (including corresponding provisions of successor regulations).

201: **\"UBTI\"** means \"unrelated business taxable income\" within the meaning of Code Sections 511 through 514, as amended.

205: **\"Withdrawal Event\"** means any event permitting or requiring the withdrawal or resignation of the General Partner from the Partnership as described in Section 12.7 of this Agreement or as otherwise provided by the Act.

207: **[Section 1.2 --- Interpretation and Construction]{.underline}**

The General Partner shall cause such amendments to the Certificate of Limited Partnership and such other filings and recordings as may be required or appropriate under the Act and the laws of any other jurisdiction in which the Partnership conducts business.

The General Partner shall have the right to change the name of the Partnership at any time and from time to time; *provided*, that the General Partner shall give prior written notice to the Limited Partners of any such change.

CONFIDENTIAL --- For Discussion Purposes Only --- Subject to Revision
